summary: The diff implements comprehensive fixes for the admin dashboard to fetch, display, and edit all 27 Nakshatras. Backend initialization and query methods are implemented, React Query hooks are properly configured with actor dependencies, AdminPage displays all Nakshatras with edit buttons and loading/error states, and AdminEditPage provides complete form functionality with image upload, validation, and save operations. All requirements appear to be addressed.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend initialize() method being called before getAllNakshatras and readNakshatra queries
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention adding an initialize() method or requiring backend initialization before queries. The requirement REQ-3 only asks to ensure query methods work correctly, not to add initialization logic.

hallucinated_features.description: Caching strategy with 5-minute staleTime configuration in React Query hooks
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify implementing any caching strategy or staleTime configuration. REQ-4 only requires fixing the hooks for proper actor integration and data fetching, not adding caching logic.

hallucinated_features.description: Navigation to /admin after successful save in AdminEditPage
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify automatic navigation behavior after save. REQ-2 only requires save functionality to update backend data and display toast notifications, not navigation.
